question: Do the preserved v1 sufficient statistics pass a semantically valid degree-two reconstruction gate?

authority.invalidity: The v1 D gate required only a 0.10 absolute RSE improvement and therefore did not implement its stated degree-two adequacy claim.
authority.corrected_gate: Both tasks require degree-two signed projection in [0.8,1.2] and relative squared error <=0.2.

novelty: Scorer-only correction of the v1 semantic defect with raw measurements and all other frozen bars unchanged.
decision: A failure is an honest null selecting ordered layer-band conditional increments; no model rerun or threshold tuning is permitted.
